text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
“...One Daily Special Set B, please.
With a side salad.”

text_block_list.name: Cafe Lady
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, I'm so sorry!
We only have option A left~.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Lady
text_block_list.text:
For sides, all that's left is a mountain of fries...
But you're a growing Umamusume, after all.
Eat up plenty and grow big and strong!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Narita Taishin began to feel sick...
